clauses.title: Every batch-sequence guard failure names its violated condition
requires: throw Object.assign(new Error(`${subcheck}: ${message}`), { code, details: { subcheck, observed: observed === undefined ? message : observed } });

clauses.title: A guard failure with no named condition is a defect, and terminality is unchanged
clauses.section: ## CL-D55 — A guard failure must name its failed subcheck
requires: a failure with no named condition is a guard-implementation defect and its report says so
Terminality is unchanged: a true post-edit failure stays terminal with no retry or guard substitution, and an implementation-defect stop is terminal the same way.

clauses.title: Naming-duty fixtures pin the rule and the record
requires: every batch-sequence guard failure names its violated condition
CL-D55 records the naming duty and what it deliberately does not change

clauses.title: The autofix driver's stop reason names a refusal's subcheck and observed value, or calls an unnamed guard refusal a defect
requires: if (typeof d.subcheck !== 'string' || !d.subcheck) return GUARDS.has(operation) ? `guard_implementation_defect: ${operation} named no subcheck (${plain})` : plain;

clauses.title: Driver fixtures refuse a guard and pin the stop reason
requires: an overlay_freeze refusal stops the run naming its subcheck and observed value
a guard_before_edit refusal stops the run naming its subcheck and observed value
a guard refusal naming no subcheck is a guard-implementation defect, and other refusals keep their text
